Add a maxAliases loader option to load() and loadAll(), documented in README next to the other load options, that limits how many alias nodes (*ref) a single document may contain. The default -1 means no limit; 0 rejects any alias; a positive N allows at most N alias uses per document. Exceeding the limit must throw the library's YAMLException with a message containing "maxAliases" (for example "aliases exceeded maxAliases (1)"). The count resets for every document in a multi-document stream, so loadAll on two documents with one alias each succeeds with maxAliases: 1 and fails with maxAliases: 0. Documents without aliases are unaffected whatever the option. Source is under src/ (TypeScript); the package is built with npm run build and tests run with node --test "test/core/**/*.test.mjs" "test/spec/*.test.mjs".

Visible acceptance check (it must pass; it is not the only criterion): npm run build && node acceptance/visible/check.mjs
